articulation.label: spring
articulation.alt: spring: /s/ → /p/ → /r/ → /ɪ/ → /ŋ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/ŋ/: Back of tongue at soft palate; air through nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

cards.title: Read and write
sections: Puck takes pictures of a tree in every season. In spring, it has pink blossom, and he looks closely at the petals. In summer, its leaves are green. In fall, also called autumn, they turn yellow. His last picture shows the tree without leaves in winter.
What does the tree look like in fall and winter?
Write two sentences using two words from today’s new word bank.
